messages:
izzy: deploy-bot blocked the prod push for redwood/ingress:3.5.0 — provenance digest disagreement from eu-ecr mirror. holding the release.

qbot: :rotating_light: publish-guard: provenance mismatch detected
attested_manifest=sha256:faa111... registry_manifest=sha256:fbf222...
build_id=202603211020 cosign=present

mike: did staging canary skip the full provenance check?

olga: correct, only gating runs the full attestation validation. canary was smoke-green.

izzy: logs show the registry rewrote the manifest after dedupe step during multipart push. small patch: retag as 3.5.0-hotfix1 and republish with canonical manifest ordering?

pat: +1 to republish under a new tag. less churn than rewriting the original tag. also include a short note in the release notes about a republish due to registry rewrite.

deploy-bot: attach excerpt:
```
2026-03-21T10:20:13Z WARN registry-proxy: dedupe rewrite applied
2026-03-21T10:20:14Z INFO attestor: attestation created (manifest=sha256:faa111...)
2026-03-21T10:20:15Z INFO registry: stored manifest sha256:fbf222...
2026-03-21T10:20:15Z ERROR provenance: attested vs registry manifest mismatch
```

olga: I'll pull the blobs from eu-ecr, canonicalize the manifest (sort entries), push as 3.5.0-hotfix1, and re-attest with cosign.

izzy: plan sounds good. please queue manual_republish and ping QA when ready.

olga: manual_republish queued. pulling layers & checksum-verify now.

olga: canonical manifest pushed as redwood/ingress:3.5.0-hotfix1 -> digest sha256:fcg333... Attestation uploaded with same cosign key.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: republish complete. registry_manifest=sha256:fcg333... attestation attached.

mike: starting full provenance lint + canary smoke on hotfix1.

pat: decision: DO NOT promote original 3.5.0 tag. promote 3.5.0-hotfix1 to canary, run gradual rollout if QA green. keep original tag pinned for 1 hour and add an audit entry.

izzy: noted. updating release-notes.md: "Republished artifact as 3.5.0-hotfix1 due to upstream manifest rewrite during push; original 3.5.0 held." QA team, ping when green.

mike: QA green after provenance lint + smoke. requesting 5% gradual rollout.

deploy-bot: manual rollout requested by mike: route 5% traffic to redwood/ingress:3.5.0-hotfix1.

pat: monitoring looks normal at 5%. will ramp per rollout playbook. follow-up: add gating check to run provenance lint earlier in pipeline to catch this before staging promotion.

izzy: thanks all — logging this thread in the release audit and closing the temporary hold. :thumbsup:
